name: B10-0073/2024 (ECR) – Strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian interference ahead of the upcoming presidential elections and a constitutional referendum on EU integration
title: Resolution on strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian interference ahead of the upcoming presidential elections and a constitutional referendum on EU integration
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to help Moldova protect its presidential election on 20 October 2024 from Russian interference. It asks for money and experts to train election observers, better voting technology, a growth plan for Moldova, and more sanctions on people and media spreading Russian influence. It also condemns Russia's attempts to destabilise Moldova and backs Moldova's path to EU membership. The text is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- The EU is asked to fund election observers and secure voting technology for Moldova's October vote.
- Moldova, its voters and its institutions are the focus, along with Russian actors facing sanctions.
- Next, EU bodies and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
